channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 24
item.description:
50 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed frog animation issues: frogs now play correct animations, stop skating sideways, and have proper movement speed.
  • UI store prop drawer failures fixed, added fallback for missing images, and automated copying of original resources to DynamicResourceRef for better dynamic bundle handling.
  • Hotbar swapping with overstacks now works correctly; server‑side RPC moved while preserving admin checks.
  • Navmesh generation errors fixed: building volumes no longer baked, invalid navmesh creation prevented, and path‑following optimized.

Animals

  • Fixed frog animation issues: frogs now play correct animations, stop skating sideways, and have proper movement speed.
  • Livestock now need to drink water and will seek nearby water sources.

Vehicles

  • Vehicle pooling UI restored hierarchy to prevent UI glitches for vehicles.
  • Vehicle handling improved: refined suspension, steering and grip; removed broken burnout/launch; engine revs now use front wheel speed; rear wheels lock visually during handbrake.

Gameplay & UI

  • UI store prop drawer failures fixed, added fallback for missing images, and automated copying of original resources to DynamicResourceRef for better dynamic bundle handling.
  • Arrow Revamp icons corrected.
  • Hotbar swapping with overstacks now works correctly; server‑side RPC moved while preserving admin checks.
  • Aim sway now scales with movement speed when firing weapons from the passenger seat of the attack helicopter.

NPC & AI

  • Navmesh generation errors fixed: building volumes no longer baked, invalid navmesh creation prevented, and path‑following optimized.

Crafting & Items

  • Repair bench and cached skin ID issues resolved, improving stability of random skin crafting.
  • Default skin added to random skin pool, making it obtainable through random crafting.

Stability & Economy

  • Rust.Native binaries updated to prevent stale binary crashes; game now boots without exception.
  • Potential null reference exception for mannequins fixed.
  • Tax Collector upkeep now scales with authorized players: first 4 add 0%, next 6 add 2% each, any beyond add 4% each; de‑authorization takes 24 h to affect upkeep.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 22
item.description:
11 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed heavy scientists getting stuck after being dropped by the helicopter on certain seeds (small oilrig).

Deployable Physics & Collisions

  • Fixed mismatched colliders and off‑center gib origins for multiple deployables (io.table, HotAirBalloon armor, sculpture.ice, mannequin, chandelier, component.box.charcoal.large, HotAirBalloon basket, refinery, windmill, wooden box, fireplace, lift shaft top, tool cupboard, cannon, component box wood), eliminating clipping and improving break‑apart physics.
  • Added gib pieces to the Frankenstein table so it now breaks apart correctly when destroyed.

Grenade Stack Sizes

  • Reduced stack sizes for F1 grenades, Bee grenades, Flashbangs, and Molotovs from 5 to 3.
